definitions.gloss: heavy oil; fuel oil; bunker oil
definitions.explanation: A dark, viscous petroleum product used as fuel for ships, power plants, and industrial boilers. It is the residue left after lighter fractions like gasoline and diesel have been distilled from crude oil.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{重油|じゅうゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: This ship runs on heavy oil.

examples.english: The price of heavy oil is rising.

examples.japanese: タンカー⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{重油|じゅうゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流出|りゅうしゅつ}→流出：13327_ryuushutsu⟧し、⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Heavy oil leaked from the tanker and the sea was contaminated.

notes:
Composed of {重|じゅう} (heavy) + {油|ゆ} (oil). Called "heavy" because it is denser and more viscous than lighter petroleum products like gasoline ({揮発油|きはつゆ}) or ⟦{軽油|けいゆ}→軽油：19777_keiyu⟧ (diesel). Classified into types A, B, and C based on viscosity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重油|じゅうゆ}⟦{流出|りゅうしゅつ}→流出：13327_ryuushutsu⟧: heavy oil spill
- {重油|じゅうゆ}⟦ボイラー→ボイラー：23741_boiraa⟧: heavy oil boiler
- {重油|じゅうゆ}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: heavy oil price
- C{重油|じゅうゆ}: C-grade heavy oil (the thickest type)
